rule: Edit run.py only; keep cp run.py run_md.py before every push
Pin openmm=8.3.1 in the micromamba env (8.6+nvrtc13.3 rejects sm_60/sm_70)
Never rely on --accelerator to choose the GPU; design for the assigned one
Reinstall kaggle CLI every fresh sandbox (key file persists, package does not)
Mount datasets via /kaggle/input/datasets/<owner>/<slug>; find_input_dir() tries that first, then falls back to /kaggle/input
After dataset re-upload, expect minutes of mount lag; poll, don't fix working code
Rebuild restraint CustomExternalForce per stage; never bare setParticleParameters on 8.3
Re-center complex into [0,box)^3 BEFORE solvation; apply same shift to ligand+ions (RECELL)
Restrain to MINIMIZED coordinates, never raw input coordinates
Remove the previous stage's restraint force before adding the next (removeForce)
Rebuild ligand via VF2 heavy-atom match + AddHs(addCoords=True); verify InChIKey vs PubChem; never EmbedMolecule+AlignMol
Do not chase post-min |F|max~3700 to zero; equilibration absorbs it
OPC O-M same-residue 0.0159 nm pair is not a clash; exclude same-residue+bonded pairs
Plan >=3 sessions: 25,000,000 steps = 29h vs ~12h cap; checkpoint every 50 ps and resume — NEVER plan a single-session 100 ns run
Run exactly ONE bounded supervisor loop, only when the human asked for it; stop on done or 3 failures
